title: The Hermit Crab Housewarming
skyStory: A thin new crescent, five percent, climbs out of the dark and lands in Cancer, the crab, sign of home and shells and pulling the blanket over your head. Cancer has just moved into a bigger shell. It is hosting a housewarming. The tide brings snacks. The stars arrive fashionably late and compliment the curtains.

reading: The cabin wants a little attention today. Not a renovation, just a fluffing. A pillow turned, a window wiped, a mug washed and put back on the hook. Cancer moons reward you for making a corner feel like a shell you want to crawl into.

You may resist this, because tidying feels like the opposite of building. It is not. You are building the place where the building happens. Choose one corner of your space and make it ten percent cozier before supper. Then sit in it and accept the compliment the room gives back.
joel.mission: Make one corner of your home ten percent cozier before supper, then sit in it for one full song.
joel.omen: A spider that has rebuilt its web overnight. Persistence at home is the theme; admire it from a distance.

reading: Down at the shore, a hermit crab is trying on a new shell and looking in a puddle to check the fit. It is you. It is so you. Something in your life is ready for a slightly bigger shell: a new routine, a new corner, a new way of saying yes.

You do not have to move out of the old one in a hurry. Crabs test first. Try the new thing on for an hour today and see how it feels. The [[Six of Swords]] is rowing gently in the background, reminding you that crossings can be done in small, comfortable trips.
nancy.mission: Try one small new habit for exactly one hour today, then decide whether it fits like a good shell.
nancy.omen: A shell with nobody inside. A space is opening up for you; you get to choose what fills it.

together.text: Hold a tiny long-distance housewarming. Each of you sends a photo of the coziest corner of your place. The other must name it something absurd, like The Pillow Embassy. From now on, those names are official and must be used whenever either corner comes up.

game.intro: A hermit crab moved into a bigger shell and threw a party. Bring three stories; one is from nowhere.
game.prompt: Three places you have lived or stayed that had a strange quirk. One quirk is made up.
